scope: Startup improvements to Dart-owned Spotify playback. These observations do not prove original-client latency or complete HTTP/TLS fingerprint parity.

limits: Read-only retained original capture, not a new account experiment.
The capture establishes shared connections for these requests; it does not establish every original pool limit, idle timeout or next-decoder admission.

changes: Session-owned standard http2 ClientPool preserves the verified pseudoheader/header writer and owns TLS/H2 connection reuse.
Session-owned standard HttpClient pool leases bodyless GET clients exclusively and resets the exact HTTP/1.1 field plan per request.
Adapters cancel their own requests. Session retirement closes shared pools. Failed/partial HTTP/1.1 bodies are not returned to the idle pool.
Bounded CPU-only synthetic warm-up before the first playback key. Generated arithmetic and real-key output behavior remain unchanged.
A successful parsed license reply admits the unchanged CDN request before local key calculation finishes; encrypted input pauses after its first delivered chunk until decryption is ready.
Newly installed songs do not wait for previous decoded-file cache retirement. Abandoned loads are checked before metadata resolution.

flutter test --no-pub test/native_cef_http_request_test.dart --plain-name 'native CEF context and HTTPS outgoing fields match original producers and shipped peer captures'
flutter test --no-pub test/native_cdn_recovery_test.dart --plain-name 'Source early-header-close failover preserves original A-to-B outgoing requests'
outgoingProof.http1: All12 original captured request shapes retain complete raw HTTP/1.1 bytes after only loopback authority/Origin substitution. Six bodyless GETs use one independently observed TLS socket while per-request adapters are replaced.
outgoingProof.http2: Existing independent shipped-CEF/native fixtures check decoded header order/values, raw target and body bytes.
outgoingProof.limits: No general UI, lifecycle, component or full-suite tests were added or run. No HTTP/2 HPACK or TLS/QUIC bit identity claim.

pipelinedColdNetworkSource.observation: Read-only inspection of a real foreground source after hot reload. No inspection-selected song or app/session restart. Uncached audio metadata, key and PCM; a real CDN range was sent.
pipelinedColdNetworkSource.clockDomains: total_ms and track_info_ms start at source resolution; other *_started/admitted/ready_ms boundaries and first_pcm_ms start after track relinking. Header, license and unwrap fields are operation durations.

outgoingRegression.baseline: Old serial source with the new observation assertion failed: expected2 CDN envelopes while key computation remained pending, actual0.
outgoingRegression.repaired: Passed canonical original A-to-B outgoing request comparison, including zero CDN dispatches before successful license admission and both exact outgoing envelopes before local key readiness.
outgoingRegression.command: flutter test --no-pub test/native_cdn_recovery_test.dart --plain-name 'Source early-header-close failover preserves original A-to-B outgoing requests'

pipelinedColdNetworkSource.limits: One live source-readiness observation, not measured click-to-audible latency or a matched original comparison. HTTP429 remains observed on other license jobs. No complete TLS/QUIC identity or server-admission claim.

firstAfterH2Change.description: Cold credentials/connections; not an improvement claim.

preparedNextAfterH2Change.description: Ordinary automatic next preparation, not audible-start timing.

live.invalidProbe: A later row-index probe ran after the visible playlist changed. It is excluded from latency evidence. The still-buffered previous song was restored only while the exact probe load34 remained current and unready; probe next preparation was withdrawn. Further playback-driving probes stopped.

remaining: License429 responses remain unresolved; later foreground responses also included429, so earlier foreground200-only observations are not a general claim.

Original ordinary key batch raw0 and gated future-key Prefetch raw2 are separately proved. The complete upstream binding/timing for the ordinary next decoder is still missing; no near-end constant or speculative interactivity change was introduced.
Cached results and server-reported restrictions remain authoritative. No original Spotify cache/profile was imported or moved.
